title: Modern HTML Fundamentals
description: A complete 16-lesson HTML track combining web.dev's modern standards with W3Schools' hands-on sandboxes, from document structure and metadata to accessible forms, native dialogs, focus management, and Web Components.
outcomes: Structure valid, SEO-friendly documents with proper metadata and landmarks
Master global attributes, inline semantics, lists, navigation, and data tables
Embed responsive images, audio/video captions, SVG, Canvas, and sandboxed iframes
Build accessible, validated HTML forms with modern input types
Use native <dialog>, Popover API, focus management, and <template>/<slot>
